_about: StaticOS in Spanish (neutral Latin-American Spanish, informal tú). Keys are the English text exactly as written in t('…'); a missing key shows English. Written by hand; no machine translation. Entries whose key is an English plural hold { one, other }. Keys starting with _ are notes and are never shown.
